spec_text:
Task: write a Python function solve(haystack, needle) that returns the index of the first position at which the string needle occurs as a contiguous substring of the string haystack, or -1 if needle is not a substring of haystack. Both strings consist only of lowercase English letters, with 1 <= len(haystack) <= 2000 and 1 <= len(needle) <= 200. Indices start at 0. If needle is longer than haystack, the answer is -1.

Use only the Python standard library. Return only one ```python code block containing the function solve and any helpers, with no example usage and no explanation.

catalogue.mechanism: try every start position and compare the needle character by character (or by slicing) against the window
precompute the failure/prefix function of the needle and scan the haystack once without moving backwards
compare a rolling polynomial hash of each window with the needle's hash and verify on a hash match
compute the Z-array of needle + separator + haystack and report the first position whose Z-value equals the needle length
compare from the right end of the window and shift by a bad-character table built from the needle
delegate to Python's built-in substring search: str.find, str.index or the in operator
